rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's eighteen builder trees go (jacarandas, ficus, corals and magnolias along the back fences, a magnolia and a jacaranda 3 m from the house fronts, a few in the yards inside the wrought-iron fence); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the patio set, the grill, the swing set, on the open lot corner and in a yard inside the iron fence.
